svg.title: Sandbox layers
svg.desc: The host runs the judge worker container: every capability dropped, no new privileges, read only root, Docker's default seccomp profile plus the namespace calls, and a network that reaches only the API and Redis. Inside, each run gets an nsjail sandbox with new user, PID, network and mount namespaces, uid 65534, rlimits, a syscall filter and read only system directories. The test answers and the worker's files stay outside every sandbox.

g.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Host (on AWS: EC2 for judges only, IMDSv2 hop limit 1)
cap_drop ALL · no-new-privileges · read-only root · seccomp: Docker default plus namespace calls
network: the API and Redis only · secrets: JUDGE_TOKEN, REDIS_URL · pids and memory limits
nsjail, one per run: compile, each test, each checker
namespaces: user (uid 65534), PID, network (no route), mount, IPC, UTS
mounts: /usr /lib /bin read-only, the box, a private /tmp; no /proc, no /etc/shadow
rlimits: CPU, address space, processes, file size, open files, stack; wall clock
syscall filter: unshare, mount, ptrace, bpf, io_uring, keyrings refused; clone3 ENOSYS
stdin: this test's input only · one CPU · first to be killed under memory pressure
